---
title: "Quality of life — no-treatment sentinel"
subtitle: "Reduced API/data sentinel before primary principal-stratum fits"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This deliberately reduced, no-treatment sentinel exercises the first-order
`markov.misc::blrm_markov()` contract before the 50 full treatment branches
are fitted. It uses no invented records: the locked, schema-validated inputs
must be present and contain at least one usable transition.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
cohort_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
qol_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-qol.parquet")
cohort_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
qol_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "qol.yml")
output_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "no-treatment-sentinel.rds")
stage_id <- "primary-qol-no-treatment-sentinel"
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "data-validation.R"),
  here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"), here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-sentinel
#| include: false
module_branch(
  runtime = runtime,
  stage_id = stage_id,
  input_paths = c(cohort_path, qol_path, cohort_schema_path, qol_schema_path),
  output_paths = output_path,
  code_paths = code_paths,
  metadata = list(endpoint = "quality_of_life", sentinel = TRUE, assignment = "none"),
  worker = function() {
    cohort <- module_input(cohort_path, cohort_schema_path)
    qol <- module_input(qol_path, qol_schema_path)
    module_require_columns(cohort, c("id", "tx", "randomization_date", "death_date"), "cohort_follow_up")
    module_require_columns(qol, c("id", "day", "q30", "baseline_q30"), "qol")
    cohort <- derive_survival_endpoint(
      cohort,
      origin_col = "randomization_date",
      death_date_col = "death_date",
      follow_up_end_col = "follow_up_end_date",
      lock_date = parse_analysis_date(config$analysis$data_lock, "data_lock", allow_missing = FALSE),
      horizon_days = 182L
    )
    survivors <- cohort[cohort$event_death == 0L, c("id", "tx"), drop = FALSE]
    observations <- merge(qol, survivors, by = "id", all = FALSE)
    observations <- observations[observations$day > 0 & observations$day <= 182, , drop = FALSE]
    observations$week <- pmax(1L, pmin(26L, ceiling(observations$day / 7)))
    observations$y <- q30_to_analysis_state(observations$q30, strict = FALSE)
    observations <- observations[!is.na(observations$y), , drop = FALSE]
    observations <- observations[order(observations$id, observations$week, observations$day), , drop = FALSE]
    observations <- observations[!duplicated(observations[c("id", "week")], fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    observations$yprev <- ave(observations$y, observations$id, FUN = function(value) c(NA, head(value, -1L)))
    observations$yprev[is.na(observations$yprev)] <- observations$y[match(observations$id[is.na(observations$yprev)], observations$id)]
    observations$gap <- 1
    observations <- observations[!is.na(observations$yprev), c("id", "week", "y", "yprev", "gap"), drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(observations) < 2L) stop("No-treatment QoL sentinel has no usable transitions.")
    observations$tx <- 0L
    observations$y <- factor(observations$y, levels = 1:7, ordered = TRUE)
    observations$yprev <- factor(observations$yprev, levels = 1:7, ordered = FALSE)
    model_formula <- y ~ rms::rcs(week, 3) + yprev + gap
    fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "qol")
    fit <- tryCatch(
      markov.misc::blrm_markov(
        formula = model_formula,
        data = observations,
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
        iter = as.integer(config$markov$iterations),
        warmup = as.integer(config$markov$warmup),
        seed = fit_seed,
        refresh = 0L
      ),
      error = identity
    )
    diagnostics <- if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      fit
    } else {
      tryCatch(markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics), error = identity)
    }
    retry <- inherits(fit, "error") || inherits(diagnostics, "error") ||
      !isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)
    if (retry) {
      if (!isTRUE(config$diagnostics$retry_on_failure)) {
        stop("QoL sentinel fit failed and retries are disabled.")
      }
      fit <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
        formula = model_formula,
        data = observations,
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
        iter = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations),
        warmup = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L),
        seed = as.integer(fit_seed + 500000L),
        refresh = 0L
      )
      diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics)
    }
    assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
    module_save_rds(list(model = fit, diagnostics = diagnostics), output_path)
  }
)
```
